integrity: Independent audit has not been performed. Universal conclusions follow from analytical arguments; bounded numerical checks are corroborative.
scientific_limitations: Exact idealized stationary symmetric random-telegraph dephasing with Gaussian independent clock jitter, one instantaneous x-axis rotation, pure equatorial initial qubit, infinite observation horizon and no bandwidth constraint for time-conditioned control; ensemble capacity only. Does not account for device work, non-Gaussian errors or finite-time readout. Priority assessment is literature-limited.
title: Clock-resolution frontier for harvesting telegraph-noise qubit capacity
